bad-mapping.description: Index has incorrect field type mappings causing poor search, aggregation, and sorting behavior

problems.impact: Cannot do date range queries, date histograms, or sort by time. Text analysis on ISO timestamps is useless.
Cannot do full-text search on order descriptions. Keyword requires exact match which is impractical for free-text descriptions.
Cannot aggregate by key type. Text analysis splits values unnecessarily. Terms aggregation on text fields is disabled by default.
Cannot do range queries, percentile aggregations, or sort numerically. All comparisons are lexicographic.
Cannot aggregate by order status efficiently. Text analysis unnecessary for status values.
Cannot filter or aggregate by customer ID. Text analysis splits 'cust-123' into tokens.

bad-mapping.fix: Reindex with correct mappings. Create new index with proper types, use _reindex API to copy data, then swap aliases.
